contents.title: The company was awarded the Annual Best Technology Innovation Award.
contents.summary: At the 2024 Science and Technology Innovation Conference, our company received this honor due to our technological strength.
contents.content:
At the recently held 2024 Science and Technology Innovation Conference, our company was awarded the "Best Annual Science and Technology Innovation Award" for its outstanding contributions in the fields of IoT and edge computing.

The selection was organized by the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, and after rigorous evaluation by an expert committee, we stood out from hundreds of participating enterprises.

Award Highlights

  • Self-developed IoT protocol stack, compatible with 100+ industrial protocols
  • Edge AI inference engine, supporting millisecond-level real-time decision-making
  • A total of 32 technology patents filed, including 12 invention patents

The company's CEO stated: "This award is a recognition of our team's continuous innovation, and we will continue to increase our R&D investment in the future."

contents.title: PHP 8.0 New Features Explained
contents.summary: In-depth analysis of the performance improvements and new syntax features brought by PHP 8.0.
contents.content:
PHP 8.0 is a major version update of the PHP language, bringing many exciting new features.

JIT Compiler

PHP 8.0 introduces JIT support, achieving performance improvements of up to 3 times in compute-intensive scenarios.

Named Arguments

Named arguments make code more readable, eliminating the need to remember the order of parameters.

Union Types

Native support for union type declarations reduces reliance on PHPDoc annotations.

Match Expression

match is a modern alternative to switch, supporting strict comparison and returning values.
contents.seo_keywords: PHP8, JIT, Named Parameters, Technical Sharing
contents.seo_description: In-depth analysis of important new features of PHP 8.0.

contents.title: Service Process
contents.content:
We ensure efficient delivery and customer satisfaction for every project through standardized service processes.

1

Requirement Communication

Engage in in-depth discussions with clients to understand business scenarios and specific needs. Through on-site surveys, requirement interviews, etc., produce a detailed requirements specification.

2

Solution Design

Develop technical solutions and implementation plans based on requirements, including system architecture design, hardware selection, network planning, and project scheduling. Submit the proposal and seek client confirmation.

3

Development & Implementation

Proceed with development and deployment according to the confirmed plan. Adopt agile development methodology, report progress to clients regularly, and invite clients to participate in acceptance at key milestones.

4

Testing & Acceptance

Conduct comprehensive system testing, including functional testing, performance testing, security testing, and user acceptance testing. Ensure the system is stable and reliable before delivery and go-live.

5

Training & Handover

Provide operational and technical training to the client's team, deliver complete technical documentation and user manuals, ensuring the client can independently manage operations.

6

After-Sales Support

Offer a 7×24 hour technical support hotline, regular inspections, and system optimization. Respond quickly to faults and ensure long-term stable operation of the system.
contents.seo_keywords: Service Process, Project Delivery, Technical Support
contents.seo_description: Standardized Six-Step Service Process: Requirements Communication, Solution Design, Development Implementation, Testing and Acceptance, Training and Delivery, After-Sales Support.

contents.title: What communication protocols do your products support?
contents.summary: Our IoT gateway supports over 100 industrial protocols, including MQTT, HTTP, Modbus, OPC UA, and more.
contents.content:
Our IoT gateway product supports a wide range of communication protocols, including but not limited to:

  • IoT Protocols: MQTT, CoAP, HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket
  • Industrial Protocols: Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC UA, Profinet, EtherCAT
  • Wireless Protocols: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee, LoRa, NB-IoT, 4G/5G
  • Database Protocols: MySQL, PostgreSQL, InfluxDB, TDengine

It also supports custom protocol development, which can be tailored to meet specific customer requirements.
contents.seo_keywords: Communication protocols, MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA
contents.seo_description: Our IoT gateway supports 100+ industrial protocols including MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA, and more.

contents.title: The typical project implementation cycle generally ranges from 3 to 12 months, depending on the project's scope, complexity, and specific requirements.
contents.summary: Depending on the project scale, the implementation cycle typically ranges from 1 to 6 months.
contents.content:
The project implementation timeline depends on the scale and complexity of the project:

  • Small projects (single scenario, up to 50 devices): 1-2 months
  • Medium projects (multiple scenarios, up to 200 devices): 2-4 months
  • Large projects (group-level, cross-regional deployment): 4-6 months

We adopt an agile development model, which allows for quick delivery of an MVP version with core features in the early stages of the project, followed by gradual iteration and refinement.
contents.seo_keywords: Project lifecycle, implementation plan, agile development
contents.seo_description: The project implementation cycle typically ranges from 1 to 6 months depending on the scale, utilizing agile development for rapid delivery.

contents.title: Do you support private deployment?
contents.summary: Supported. All of our software products support both private deployment and SaaS models.
contents.content:
Yes, all our software products support two deployment modes:

Private Deployment

  • Deployed on customer's own servers or private cloud
  • Data is fully under customer's control
  • Supports offline operation on intranet
  • Suitable for enterprises with strict data security requirements

SaaS Cloud Service

  • Ready to use out of the box, no maintenance required
  • Pay-as-you-go, flexible scalability
  • Automatic updates, continuous iteration
  • Suitable for SMEs looking for quick startup
contents.seo_description: Supports both on-premises deployment and SaaS cloud service models to meet the needs of different enterprises.

contents.title: What does after-sales service include?
contents.summary: Providing 7×24 technical support, periodic inspections, system upgrades, and remote operation and maintenance services.
contents.content:
Our after-sales service system includes:

  • Technical Support: 7×24 hotline and online customer service
  • Fault Response: Response within 4 hours for general issues, within 1 hour for urgent issues
  • Periodic Inspection: On-site or remote system inspection once per quarter
  • System Upgrade: Free version upgrade service within one year
  • Remote Operation: Remote assistance for troubleshooting and problem resolution via a secure channel
  • Knowledge Base: Online documentation and video tutorials provided

The warranty period is 12 months from delivery, with extended warranty service available for purchase.
